name: SKYBARS | АНАРХИЯ • ВЫЖИВАНИЕ • ОДИН БЛОК
description:
SkyBars - free Minecraft server for phone and PC. Bedrock (MCPE) and Java crossplay, versions 1.8 up to the latest.

FREE DONATE - type /FREE in chat and get ranks, cases and in-game money instantly. No payment required.

Game modes: Survival, SMP, Anarchy, Hardcore, GTA RP, Roleplay, BedWars, SkyWars, SkyBlock, OneBlock, Prison, Parkour, Creative, Hunger Games, Duels 1v1, Murder Mystery, Hide and Seek, Dropper, Pixelmon and Anime servers.

In-game voice chat, land claim protection, clans with rating and stats, PvP arena, auction, economy, jobs, quests and events. 24/7 anticheat, no lags, online for 6+ years.

Website: https://skybars.me
